clue.text: Mutual respect shown in big town keeping order

indicators.note: the big town holds the order within it, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a city is a big town
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A civic virtue on show in a well-run city.
explanation.walkthrough: The Order of Merit is a British honour given by the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Comity is courteous goodwill between nations or people, a formal synonym for mutual respect.

clue.text: All the players losing could get one depressed

parts.note: the cast is every actor in a production
a team that is down is losing

explanation.surface: A whole team on a losing streak might feel low.
explanation.definitionFit: To be cast down is an idiom for being dejected or low in spirits.

clue.text: Hospital employee's unusual surname the Parisian adopted

indicators.note: the shuffled letters take in the French article
the letters of surname are made unusual by rearranging them

parts.note: le is French for the

explanation.surface: A hospital worker with an odd surname took on a French article.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' makes MANURSE; the 's of 'employee's' is just 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A male nurse is a man working in the nursing profession, a hospital staff member.

clue.text: Humour shown over Arp's first method of painting

indicators.note: in a down entry the mood sits above the next letter

parts.note: humour as in mood or disposition is temper

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of the artist's name

explanation.surface: An artist's mood revealed in Jean Arp's painting technique.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempera is painting with pigment bound in egg yolk, a technique used before oils.

clue.text: A bodybuilder's heavenly body?

parts.note: a steroid is the drug associated with a bodybuilder, the bodybuilder's aid

explanation.surface: A muscleman's physique jokingly called heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'heavenly body' is meant in the astronomical sense, not as praise for a physique.
explanation.definitionFit: An asteroid is a small rocky object orbiting the sun, one kind of celestial object.

clue.text: This may tarnish top-notch household cutlery

parts.note: sterling means excellent or of high quality
the silver is the family's knives, forks and spoons

explanation.surface: A warning that the best cutlery may discolour.
explanation.definitionFit: Sterling silver is an alloy that darkens over time when exposed to air, so it tarnishes.

clue.text: Advocate has foremost of degrees in English Language?

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the following pieces

parts.note: Norse is the old language of Scandinavia

indicators.note: the foremost letter of degrees

explanation.surface: Someone backing a degree course in English Language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'English Language' reads as a subject; it splits into E and NORSE.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a cause is to support it publicly, which is what endorsing does.

clue.text: Kept in readiness in old Mediterranean resort

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: Something stored ready in an old Riviera resort town.
explanation.definitionFit: Plans put on ice are held in reserve, set aside until needed.

clue.text: The Italian employed in time to prepare pupils for examination?

indicators.note: the Italian article is placed inside the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: An Italian teacher hired for a period to coach students for exams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pupils' suggests schoolchildren; they are the pupils of the eye, widened by an optician before an eye test.
explanation.definitionFit: An eye doctor uses drops to widen the pupils before examining the retina.

clue.text: Pip, unfriendly and staid, fully alert?

parts.note: a pip is a fruit stone
cold means distant or unfriendly
sober means serious or staid

explanation.surface: Someone called Pip, cold and serious, wide awake.
explanation.definitionFit: Stone-cold sober means completely clear-headed, without a trace of drink.

clue.text: Auction last of them in state capital

parts.note: an auction is a sale

indicators.note: points to the final letter of the word them

explanation.surface: An auction held in a state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem is the capital city of Oregon in the United States.

clue.text: Leader of team assigned to study factory's monotonous routine

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, here of team

parts.note: to read a subject at university is to study it
a mill is a factory; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A team leader is sent to examine a factory's dull daily grind.
explanation.definitionFit: Figuratively, a treadmill is tedious work that repeats endlessly without progress.

clue.text: Manure one spread in pen?

parts.note: dung is manure

indicators.note: the letters of one are spread about into a new order

explanation.surface: Manure spread inside an animal pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread' looks like muck-spreading but makes EON. 'pen' suggests a farm enclosure; the question mark admits it is a prison cell.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen can be any place of confinement, and a dungeon is an underground prison cell.

clue.text: Most magnanimous popular gestures at heart

indicators.note: the letters lie in the middle of the phrase popular gestures

explanation.surface: Popular gestures that are the most generous at heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Large can mean generous in spirit, so the superlative means most generous.

clue.text: Cartoon crew was playing a piece for piano and orchestra

definitions.text: a piece for piano and orchestra

indicators.note: the letters of cartoon, crew and was are played about with into a new order

explanation.surface: An animated film's staff performing a piano concerto.
explanation.definitionFit: The Warsaw Concerto is a short work for piano and orchestra by Richard Addinsell, written for a 1941 film.

clue.text: Worry about half of them covering athletics event

indicators.note: the first pieces are wrapped around the half word

parts.note: a trial is a source of worry or trouble

indicators.note: takes the first two of the four letters of them

parts.note: on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Fretting over half the competitors in a sporting event.
explanation.definitionFit: A triathlon is an endurance race combining swimming, cycling and running.

clue.text: Strong former US soldier taking on tough guys

indicators.note: the veteran takes the tough guys into himself

parts.note: a vet is an American veteran, an ex-serviceman
he-men are macho, tough men

explanation.surface: A burly ex-GI squaring up to some hard men.
explanation.definitionFit: Vehement means forceful and intense, as a strong protest is.

clue.text: Cocktail: liqueur in, as set out

indicators.note: the letters of liqueur in as set are put out of order

explanation.surface: A recipe step: set out a liqueur for a cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set' looks like part of 'set out' but belongs to the fodder; 'out' alone signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A tequila sunrise is a mixed drink of tequila, orange juice and grenadine.

clue.text: Young dog with no lead, stopped, then flipped over

indicators.note: the leading letter of the young dog is removed

parts.note: a pup is a young dog
ended means stopped

explanation.surface: A puppy off its lead halts, then rolls over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no lead' looks like a dog off the leash; it drops the first letter of PUP.
explanation.definitionFit: Something upended has been turned upside down.

clue.text: Without competence, in particular

definitions.meaning: read as two words, ... means without skill

explanation.surface: Especially lacking ability.
explanation.definitionFit: As one word it means especially; split, the same letters mean not skilfully.

clue.text: Attracts short-term office workers? About time!

indicators.note: the office workers go around the letter for time

parts.note: temps are temporary office staff

explanation.surface: Agency staff arrive at last, and that draws people in.
explanation.definitionFit: To tempt is to lure or entice, so attracts is a synonym.

clue.text: Indicate fast train

explanation.surface: A signal showing that a fast train is due.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a verb meaning convey and as a noun for a rapid train service.

clue.text: Italian dish in Dad's Army?

parts.note: pa is dad, with its 's
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: An Italian meal turning up in the British TV sitcom Dad's Army.
explanation.walkthrough: Dad's Army is a British sitcom about the wartime Home Guard; the title has to be broken apart rather than read as a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is the staple Italian food of dough shaped into noodles and other forms.

clue.text: Record losses exceeded that in this big enterprise, initially

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of each word from losses to enterprise

explanation.surface: A business venture's losses beat all previous records.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record' looks like a ledger entry or a best-ever figure; it is a pop record.
explanation.definitionFit: Let It Be is a 1970 Beatles single and album, so a record.

clue.text: Quiet by area, so the Spanish bloke returned for a dance

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: sends the Spanish article and the bloke back the other way

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
bod is British slang for a person or bloke

explanation.surface: A quiet Spanish man comes back to join a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The paso doble is a fast Spanish-style ballroom dance modelled on a bullfight march.

clue.text: Beautiful girl in British lifestyle magazine

parts.note: Elle is a fashion and lifestyle magazine

explanation.surface: A pretty girl featured in a British magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A belle is a beautiful woman, often the most admired one at an event.

clue.text: Model, celebrity, going around with daughter

indicators.note: the celebrity surrounds the other piece

parts.note: a celebrity is a star
and means with, joining things together
D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter

explanation.surface: A famous model out and about with her daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a benchmark or exemplar against which others are judged, as a model is.

clue.text: Young swan and small seal heard

indicators.note: the word for a small seal is said out loud

parts.note: a signet is a small seal, as on a ring

explanation.surface: Wildlife sightings: a baby swan and a seal pup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seal' suggests the animal beside the swan; it is the stamp on a signet ring.
explanation.definitionFit: Cygnet is the standard term for an immature swan.
